subject: Action required: W-8BEN-E notarization option for PacificEdge onboarding
messages:
From: David Kim <david.kim@redwoodinference.com>

Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 18 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Action required: W-8BEN-E notarization option for PacificEdge onboarding

Hi Tom —

Thanks for choosing Redwood. We're working to get your procurement record ready so we can issue a PO and unlock payment terms. One outstanding item from our finance onboarding checklist is a completed W-8BEN-E with evidence of signatory authority. Our preferred path is a notarized W-8BEN-E (wet or remote notary) or an apostilled bank letter plus company registry extract for UK entities.

Can you confirm whether PacificEdge is able to provide a notarized W-8BEN-E? If notarization isn't possible, please confirm you can provide one of the alternatives below: 
- Bank letter on bank letterhead (signed and dated within 90 days) showing account ownership + corporate stamp or apostille OR
- Company registry extract (Companies House) + DocuSign envelope with certified signature from your authorized signatory and a corroborating email from your accountant or legal counsel.

To help, I've attached the blank W-8BEN-E template we use and our secure upload paths. If you prefer a video-notary option (tele-notary) we can accept that in some cases; we'll need a notarization certificate in the DocuSign/attachment.

Timelines: once we receive verified docs our procurement team typically issues the PO within 3 business days. If you have a commercial start date, let me know and I'll flag the account for expedited review.

Attachments: W-8BEN-E_template.pdf (fillable)
Secure upload: sftp://upload.redwood-inference.com/pacificedge-onboard
DocuSign (optional): https://docusign.com/envelope/ABC-123-pacificedge

Thanks — appreciate a quick read.

Best,
David Kim
Procurement Specialist | Redwood Inference
david.kim@redwoodinference.com
+1 415-555-0123

--

Hi David —

Thanks for the heads-up. We prefer to avoid wet-notary signatures in the UK for tax forms when possible (logistics/turnaround). Our legal team drafted a completed W-8BEN-E and we'd like to propose the following deliverables instead of an in-person notarization: 

1) Bank letter from Atlantic Bank (on bank letterhead, signed and dated within 60 days) confirming account ownership;
2) Companies House certified extract showing officers/registered address;
3) DocuSign envelope with our CEO's signature; our DocuSign account has signer authentication and an audit trail.

We can also do a tele-notary session if Redwood requires a notary stamp on the W-8BEN-E specifically — that would add 2-3 business days. Our team estimates we can have the bank letter + registry extract + DocuSign ready by Apr 25. I've attached the draft W-8BEN-E for your review.

Attachment: PacificEdge_signed_w8bene_draft.pdf (draft; awaiting bank letter and registry extract)

Let me know whether the bank letter + registry extract + certified DocuSign is acceptable to finalize the vendor record and push PO issuance.

Best,
Tom Evans
Head of Finance Operations | PacificEdge Ltd.
tom.evans@pacificedge.co.uk
+44 20 7946 0901

Tom / Team —

Appreciate the quick response and the draft. After a short policy check with legal/procurement, we can accept the following package as an alternative to a notarized W-8BEN-E for PacificEdge (UK entity):

Required deliverables (minimal acceptable):
- Bank letter on bank letterhead (signed by authorized bank officer, dated within 90 days) that includes account name and confirmation of account holder; bank stamp or bank-provided PDF with bank domain header preferred.
- Companies House certified extract showing registered officers and registered address (electronic certified extract acceptable).
- DocuSign envelope containing the completed W-8BEN-E signed by an authorized officer; please include the DocuSign envelope ID and the signer authentication method in the cover email.
- Cover email from your external counsel or accountant confirming signatory authority (name + role + contact).

Once we receive and validate the package we'll run the documents through our KYC team. If everything checks, Procurement will issue the PO within 3 business days. If KYC flags anything, we may ask for tele-notary proof or a notarized W-8BEN-E as a fallback.

Action items for PacificEdge: please upload the bank letter and registry extract to the secure SFTP above OR send the DocuSign envelope link and accompanying cover email. If you'd rather Redwood send a DocuSign envelope to your CEO directly, reply and we will initiate it.

I'll mark this as high priority for the PO queue once docs arrive.

Thanks —
David Kim
Procurement Specialist | Redwood Inference
